name: Fed-dovish liquidity-easing regime gate (macro_regime-armed) firing a falling-DXY crypto long
rationale: Thesis: the paper's Fed-dovish channel predicted BTC vol at t=3.63 but was EXPLICITLY regime-dependent — it only paid inside the 2024-25 easing cycle and decayed afterward. The tradable read is therefore CONDITIONAL, not a standalone signal: a dollar-liquidity-easing repricing is a risk-on trigger for crypto ONLY while the macro regime is already in its easing/risk-on band; outside that band the same impulse is noise. We proxy the un-ingested Polymarket Fed-cut contract with a falling-DXY cross (a dollar-easing impulse) that is ARMED only when macro_regime sits above a fitted risk-on/easing floor. macro_regime is a BOUNDED FRED composite (curve slope, real rates, liquidity), so a fitted floor genuinely binds; dxy is a DRIFTING level so it enters ONLY via cross_down (the impulse), never a raw lt/gt. The regime-conditionality is exactly what a naive single-signal backtest misses, and what makes this look like an edge funds 'missed' — it is fragile by construction. DISCONFIRMER: the control is dxy cross_down ALONE, with NO macro_regime arm — that is the already-EXHAUSTED 'dollar-weakness as sole signal' and it must FAIL net of fees. If the regime-gated version does not beat the bare dxy cross net of the 10bps taker fee, the regime arm is cosmetic and this is a STOP. We further expect the gate to DEGRADE in the non-easing sub-period (confirming genuine regime-dependence) yet still NET-survive the full purged holdout, not just the easing cherry-pick. Low turnover by design: a cross-down impulse fires rarely and a 10-day time stop caps churn so the taker fee does not eat the edge.
catalyst: a dollar-liquidity-easing (falling-DXY) impulse firing INSIDE a risk-on / easing macro regime
